verdict_reason: 403-to-undefined mapping meets the AC (frontend shows 404) and is tested in real.requests.test.js, but the refusal branch is silent in the frontend log.

todos.issue: The new 403 branch (lines 21-23) turns the backend's refusal of another organisation's notification into 'not found' and logs nothing, so the frontend's log never shows that a signed-in user was refused a notification; support cannot tell a cross-organisation read from a genuinely missing reference during an incident. The house rule: another service refusing what this one accepted logs once at warn with the ids support searches by. The module already has a logger (records/real/logger.js) that nothing here uses.
todos.fix: Must: when the backend answers 403 for a fulfilment read, the frontend logs it once at warn with the journey reference (and the caller's organisation id) before returning undefined. One way: import { logger } from '../logger.js' and in the 403 branch call logger.warn({ journeyId }, 'Backend refused fulfilment read for another organisation') before return undefined.
